description:
Compile the criteria patterns of rules once, when declarations load, through one pattern type.

## Background

`criteria-to-check` and `criteria-label-match` compile their regex on each evaluation (`crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:1608,1781`), although the comment at `:1606` says the pattern was validated at load; `declarations/rules.rs` compiles none. `regex::Regex` has no `PartialEq`, while `Rule` and `Assertion` derive it (`rules.rs:768`). `ItemKind` stores a source string beside its compiled regex (`domain/item.rs:643-655`). The default criteria pattern is spelled at `graph.rs:72` and `rules.rs:1455`. `RuleConfigError::InvalidAssertion { rule, message }` names the failing rule.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: An `IdPattern` type holds a pattern's source and compiled regex, compares and serializes by source, and fails construction on an invalid source.
- [hard] REQ-02: The `criteria-to-check` and `criteria-label-match` patterns compile at declaration load, and an invalid pattern fails loading with an error naming the rule.
- [hard] REQ-03: Evaluating those assertions compiles no regex, and the default pattern is spelled once.
title: Rule patterns compile at declaration load
